findings.note: Heading level wrong: its siblings 4.3.8.3 Function-Identifier, 4.3.8.4 Reference Modification and 4.3.8.5 Identifier (page 169) are level-4 (####), and the parent 4.3.8 Uniqueness of Reference is level 3 (###); this subsection is emitted at the parent's level, so the outline makes Condition-Name a sibling of 4.3.8 rather than a child. (The renumbering to 4.3.8.6 is the marked Amendment 1 correction C94 and is not the finding.)
findings.why_it_matters: A heading at the wrong level (or none) breaks the document outline that section lookups and citation checks navigate by; the clause becomes unfindable by its number or is filed under the wrong parent.

findings.note: Printed as a section heading (like 6.1 IDENTIFICATION DIVISION and 6.3 DATA DIVISION, both '## ' in the markdown) but transcribed as a plain paragraph with no heading marker; its subsections are then promoted: '## 6.2.1 General Description', '## 6.2.2 Organization', '## 6.2.3 Structure' sit at level 2 where 6.1.1-6.1.3 are level 3 (###).
